page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by 32 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server includes 256 GB of system RAM, maintaining a high 1:8 core-to-memory ratio with 8 GB of memory allocated per virtual CPU.

Networking performance is rated at a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The configuration does not include local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators, necessitating network-attached storage volumes for persistent file systems and the guest operating system. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included with the virtual machine.

The 8 GB per vCPU distribution makes the instance cost-efficient in scenarios where memory requirements outpace compute needs, avoiding the overhead of paying for unneeded processor cores. The platform is suited for in-memory databases, large caching layers, distributed analytics engines, and enterprise backend applications requiring large operating memory.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, it delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256 GB of system memory. This establishes an 8 GB per vCPU ratio designed for high memory density. The instance offers 20 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. It contains no bundled local disks or GPU accelerators, relying on remote block storage solutions for disk operations and system hosting. With resources concentrated in physical memory rather than excessive compute threads, the instance delivers qualitative cost efficiency for systems constrained by RAM capacity. Recommended workloads include in-memory databases, Redis caching clusters, real-time analytics engines, and memory-intensive enterprise software deployments.
